book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Yesu u Yerusɑlɛmu duɑ
Ye bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu bɔku kuɑ bɑ turɑ wuu ɡe bɑ rɑ soku Bɛtefɑɡiɔ, Olifin ɡuurɔ mɑ Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu yiru ɡɔrɑ.
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i doo bɑru kpɑɑ te i mɛɛrɑ bɛɛn wuswɑɑɔ mi. Miyɑ i ko yɑnde kɛtɛku wɑ kɑ ɡen buu nu sɔri. I nu sɔsiɑmɑ i kɑ mɑn nɑɑwɑ.
Goo ù n bɛɛ ɡɑ̃ɑnu bikiɑ, i nɛɛ, Yinniwɑ u nin bukɑtɑ mɔ. Mii mii bɑ koo de i kɑ nu nɑ.
Yeni yɑ kuɑ kpɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔn ɡɑri yini yi kɑ koorɑ yi yi nɛɛ,

content.text: “I Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu sɔ̃ɔwɔ i nɛɛ, wee, ben sunɔ sisi ben mi.
Wi, tɔn duuduowɑ, u kɛtɛku sɔni, kɛtɛku buu kpɛmbu.”

content: Mɑ bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ dɑ bɑ kuɑ ye Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Bɑ kɑ kɛtɛku ɡe kɑ ɡen buu nɑ. Bɑ ben bekɑ tɛriɑ nin wɔllɔ mɑ bɑ derɑ Yesu u sɔni.
Mɑ tɔn wɔru ɡɑ ɡen bekɑ tɛriɑ swɑɑ sɔɔ. Gɑbɑ bɑ̃ɑ kɑko bekusu bɔɔrɑ bɑ tɛriɑ swɑɑɔ.
Tɔn be bɑ nùn ɡbiiye kɑ be bɑ nùn swĩi biruɔ, bɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, su Dɑfidin sikɑdobu wɔlle suɑ. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ domɑruɡii. U sisi kɑ Yinnin yĩsiru! Su Wɔrukoo wɔlle suɑ.
Ye u duɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, wuuɡibu kpuro bɑ biti soorɑ bɑ mɔ̀, wɑrɑ wini.
Tɔn wɔru ɡɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Yesuwɑ, Gɑlilen Nɑsɑrɛtiɡii.
Yesu u duɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ
Yesu u duɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ mɑ u be bɑ kiɑru dɔrɑmɔ kɑ be bɑ dwemɔ ɡirɑ min di. U be bɑ ɡobi kɔsimɔn tɑbulubɑ fukurɑ, kɑ totobɛrɛ dɔrobun kitɑnu.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn ɡɑri nɛɛ, “Nɛn dirɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑnɑrun diru.” Adɑmɑ bɛɛ i tu ɡɔsiɑ ɡbɛnɔbun wɑ̃ɑ yeru.
Yerɑ wɔ̃kobu kɑ yɛmɔbɑ nɑ win mi sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi mɑ u bu bɛkiɑ.
Yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robɑ mɔru kuɑ ye bɑ mɑɑmɑɑki wɑ ye u kuɑ, kɑ mɑɑ bii be bɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ bɑ mɔ̀, su Dɑfidin sikɑdobu wɔlle suɑ.
Mɑ bɑ Yesu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ sere nɔɔmɔ ye bɑ ɡerumɔ? Mɑ Yesu nɛɛ, oo, i ǹ ɡɑrire Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔɔ mi bɑ nɛɛ, “A derɑ bii piiminu kɑ bii wɛ̃ɛnu nu nun siɑrɑmɔ.”
Yen biru u bu deri u doonɑ wuu min di u dɑ Betɑniɔ u kpunɑ mi.
Yesu dɑ̃ru ɡɑru bɔ̃rusi
Sisiru bururu nɡe mɛ Yesu ɡɔsirɔ wuu mi, ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ nùn mɔ̀.
U dɑ̃ru ɡɑru wɑ swɑɑ bɑɑrɔ te bɑ rɑ soku fiɡie. U tu susi, ɑdɑmɑ wurusu tɔnɑwɑ u wɑ mi. Yerɑ u tu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɑ binu mɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Mɑ yɑnde, fiɡie ye, yɑ ɡberɑ.
Win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ yɑbu ye wɑ mɑ biti bu mwɑ. Bɑ Yesu bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ fiɡie ye, yɑ kɑ ɡberɑ mɛ mii mii.

Yesu bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ì n nɑɑnɛ doke mɑ i ǹ sikɑ mɔ̀, i ko kpĩ i ko ye nɑ fiɡie ye kuɑ. N ǹ mɑm mɛ tɔnɑ, i ko mɑɑ kpĩ i ɡuu teni sɔ̃ tu wukuro min di tu dɑ tu nim wɔ̃ku wɔri. Yɑ koo mɑɑ koorɑ mɛ.
Mɑ i nɑɑnɛ doke, ye i bikiɑ kɑnɑru sɔɔ ye kpurowɑ i ko wɑ i mwɑ.
Mɑn diyɑ Yesu u yiiko wɑ
Yesu duɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ u keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ. Yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ dɑ win mi bɑ nɛɛ, weren yiikowɑ ɑ kɑ yeni mɔ̀. Wɑrɑ nun yiiko ye wɛ̃.
Yesu bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn tii kon bɛɛ ɡɑri tiɑ ɡɑɑ bikiɑ. Ì n mɑn wisɑ, nɛn tii kon bɛɛ sɔ̃ wìn yiiko nɑ kɑ yeni mɔ̀.
Wɑrɑ u Yohɑnu ɡɔrimɑ u kɑ bɑtɛmu ko. Gusunɔ? Nɡe tɔnu. Mɑ bɑ ɡerumɔ ben tii tiinɛ sɔɔ bɑ mɔ̀, sɑ̀ n nɛɛ Gusunɔwɑ, u koo sun bikiɑ mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ sɑ ǹ Yohɑnu nɑɑnɛ doke.
Sɑ̀ n mɑɑ nɛɛ, tɔmbɑ, ye tɔn wɔru ɡɑ koo ko sɑ yen bɛrum mɔ, domi be kpurowɑ bɑ Yohɑnu ɡɑrisi Gusunɔn sɔmɔ.
Yerɑ bɑ Yesu wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ǹ yɛ̃. Mɑ Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, to, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, nɛn tii nɑ ǹ mɑɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ wìn yiiko nɑ kɑ yeni mɔ̀.
Bibu yirun mɔndu
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ i wɑ. Durɔ ɡoo win bii tɔn durɔbu yiru mɔ. Mɑ u ɡbiikoo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bii wunɛ, ɑ doo ɑ sɔmburu ko nɛn ɡbɑɑrɔ ɡisɔ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ dɔɔ. Adɑmɑ ye n sosi u bwisikɑ mɑ u dɑ.
Mɑ u mɑɑ dɑ u win bii yiruse wini sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɛ. Bii wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, too, bɑɑbɑ, kon dɑ. Adɑmɑ u ǹ de.
Be yiru ye sɔɔ, wɑrɑ u tundon kĩru kuɑ. Bɑ nɛɛ, ɡbiikoo wi. Yerɑ Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ɡbere mwɑɔbu kɑ kurɔ tɑnɔbu bɑ koo bɛɛ ɡbiiyɑ bu dɑ mi Gusunɔ u bɑndu swĩi.
Domi Yohɑnu nɑ u bɛɛ swɑɑ ɡeɑ sɔ̃ɔsi, mɑ i ǹ nùn nɑɑnɛ doke. Adɑmɑ ɡbere mwɑɔbu kɑ kurɔ tɑnɔbu beyɑ bɑ nùn nɑɑnɛ doke. Wee bɛɛ, bɑɑ mɛ i ye wɑ i ǹ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsie i nùn nɑɑnɛ doke.
Gbɑɑ wuko kɔ̃sobun ɡɑri

Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, i kpɑm mɔndu ɡɑru swɑɑ dɑkio. Yɛnu yɛ̃ro ɡoo u dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑru kuɑ mɑ u tu kɑrɑ kuɑ, mɑ u dɑ̃ɑ bii ɡɑmɑ yeru kuɑ mɑ u ɡbɑɑ kɔ̃sobun diru bɑnɑ. Yen biru u ɡbɑɑ wukobu kɑsu u bu ye nɔmu bɛriɑ mɑ u sɑnum dɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ dɑ̃ɑ binun sɔribu turɑ u win sɔm kowobu ɡɔrɑ ɡbɑɑ wuko ben mi, bu win bɔnu mwɑɑmɑ.
Adɑmɑ ɡbɑɑ wuko be, bɑ bu kunisi bɑ turo so, mɑ bɑ turo ɡo, mɑ bɑ itɑse kpenu kɑsukɑ.
Yɛnu yɛ̃ro wi, u kpɑm bu ɡɑbu ɡɔriɑ be bɑ ɡbiikobu dɑbiru kere. Dɑɑ tiɑ yerɑ bɑ ben tii kuɑ.
Yen biru u bu win bii ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ koo nɛn bii bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.
Adɑmɑ sɑɑ ye ɡbɑɑ wuko be, bɑ bii wi wɑ bɑ ɡerunɑ bɑ nɛɛ, i ǹ nùn wɑ wi u koo rɑ ɡbɑɑ te tubi di? I de su nùn ɡo kpɑ ɡbɑɑ te, tu ko bɛsɛɡiru.
Mɑ bɑ nùn sɛ̃re bɑ yɑrɑ ɡbɑɑ ten min di bɑ ɡo.
Yesu u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, sɑnɑm mɛ ɡbɑɑ yɛ̃ro win tii u koo nɑ, mbɑ u koo ɡbɑɑ wuko be kuɑ.
Bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, nɔni swɑ̃ɑrun ɡɔɔwɑ u koo kɑ tɔn kɔ̃so be ɡo, kpɑ u ɡbɑɑ wukobu ɡɑbu win ɡbɑɑru nɔmu sɔndiɑ, be bɑ ko n dɑ nùn win bɔnu wɛ̃ dɑ̃ɑ binun sɔribun sɑɑ sɔɔ.
Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ǹ ɡɑrire Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔɔ mi bɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: “Kpee te bɑnɔbɑ yinɑ, terɑ tɑ kuɑ ɡɑni ɡɔmburun dɑm.
Yinniwɑ ye kuɑ, mɑ n kuɑ mɑɑmɑɑki bɛsɛn nɔni sɔɔ.”

content: Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɑ koo bɛɛ Gusunɔn bɑndu wɔrɑri kpɑ bu tu bweseru ɡɑru wɛ̃ te tɑ koo bɑn te mɛm nɔɔwɑ. [
Bɑɑwure wi u koo kpee te wɔri tɑ koo nùn bɔɔku, wi tɑ mɑɑ wɔri tɑ koo nùn nɑmwɑ munu munu.]
Ye yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ Fɑlisibɑ bɑ Yesun mɔn ni nuɑ, bɑ tubɑ mɑ beyɑ u kɑ yɑ̃.
Yerɑ bɑ swɑɑ kɑsu bu kɑ nùn mwɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ tɔn wɔrun bɛrum kuɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɡɑ nùn ɡɑrisi Gusunɔn sɔmɔ.
